evidence.basis: abundance_<sample>: Proline's precursor ion abundance. Proline reports raw_abundance as the extracted ion chromatogram and abundance after its post-processing, which normalises when the run's quantitation settings ask for it.

raw_abundance_<sample>: Proline's raw precursor ion abundance. Proline reports raw_abundance as the extracted ion chromatogram and abundance after its post-processing, which normalises when the run's quantitation settings ask for it.

abundance_<sample> of the Protein sets sheet: Proline's protein-set abundance after its post-processing, which normalises when the run's quantitation settings ask for it. Proline sums or fits a protein set's peptide abundances as the run's quantitation settings choose, which the workbook does not state, so the kind is unknown.

raw_abundance_<sample> of the Protein sets sheet: Proline's raw protein-set abundance. Proline sums or fits a protein set's peptide abundances as the run's quantitation settings choose, which the workbook does not state, so the kind is unknown.
